policy: M01-T01 local CSPRNG policy (test-only, local host only)
rules: Fresh 128-bit random component required for every simulated claim nonce.
Timestamp, counter, model-generated text, Math.random, or predictable source MUST be rejected before claim.
Unavailable/invalid qualified CSPRNG prohibits claim creation and fails closed (BLOCKED).
Random output is excluded from deterministic-byte equality assertions; only shape/source/length are asserted deterministically.
